in_hebrew.name: Hallerson
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hallerson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English 'halig' meaning holy and 'ricsian' meaning ruler or leader. This name signifies a strong and holy ruler or leader.

in_greek.name: Hallerson
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong ruler
in_greek.long_meaning: Hallerson είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English 'halig' meaning holy and 'ricsian' meaning ruler or leader. This name signifies a strong and holy ruler or leader.

in_latin.name: Hallerson
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong ruler
in_latin.long_meaning: Hallerson est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English 'halig' meaning holy and 'ricsian' meaning ruler or leader. This name signifies a strong and holy ruler or leader.
